chunks: Those are the freed ones of Allah from the Fire.

key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah, the One granting freedom from punishment

ai.seo_question: Who are described as those freed by Allah from the Fire?
ai.summary: This narration states that certain people are those whom Allah has freed from the Fire. It conveys a promise of salvation and divine mercy for the people being described in the related context.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "They are the freed ones of Allah (swt) from the Fire."
